digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center test oracle / external integration harness
propositions: There is no official OpenAPI/Swagger spec for Jira Data Center and no way to obtain a trial license post-30 March 2026, making verification against a real instance necessary.

A vendored Dockerfile must build from the addono base by digest and reproduce the pycontribs/jira wrapper with mandatory -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout flags, as removal of either causes hard failures.

The test harness must run on native amd64 (not emulated arm64), bind loopback-only with tty+stdin_open, mount a persistent Maven cache, and provide a 20-minute readiness probe budget to account for runtime Jira downloads from maven.atlassian.com.

Personal Access Token bearer authentication must be exercised by minting a token programmatically via POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens and verifying it authenticates requests against a real Jira 8.17.1 Server instance.

Teardown and state verification must poll direct issue endpoints (/rest/api/2/issue/{key}) until 404, never consulting the search index, and the harness must detect and reject residual projects from interrupted prior runs.

The harness tests must carry the _live_jira_ready sentinel to participate in the all-skip canary, skip cleanly without REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 opt-in, and a new external-integration.yml CI job must run them independently on ubuntu-latest with --ignore flag applied to the pre-existing Cloud test job to keep canary signals unmask.
